scientific.integrity: The source RAdam gate is reduced exactly to a one-parameter polynomial inequality. Uniqueness follows from Descartes' rule, ordering follows from monotonicity in time, and the boundary asymptotic follows from an exact root equation.
limitations: Conditional on the source rho_t statistic and gate rho_t > 4.
Does not assess optimization quality of an activation time.
Software variants with a different gate have different thresholds.
Does not validate the EMA-to-SMA approximation motivating rho_t.

title: Exact automatic-warmup phase diagram for RAdam
